purpose: Normative enumerations for the expense assistant. Country codes, city tiers, currencies, categories, fixture FX rates and controlled vocabularies are defined here once. Prose in SPECIFICATION.txt explains them; this file is the machine-readable authority.

countries.name: India
countries.notes: Travel entirely within India is domestic (P01).

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.notes: UK is the package-local code used by policy 1.1 and every golden case. It is NOT ISO 3166; the ISO code is GB. Accept GB as an input alias, emit UK.

unsupported_country_behavior: Any country outside this list has no defined cap. Return HUMAN_REVIEW citing P03 or P07. Never interpolate or infer a rate.

city_tiers.notes: Tier selects the P02 domestic hotel cap. Cities outside the metro list use the "other" tier; this is not a scope limit, only a rate tier.

city_alias_rule: Normalize aliases to the canonical name before BM25 scoring, cap lookup and cache keys (P02). Matching is case-insensitive on the normalized form.
category_notes: Meals are out_of_scope in release 1 (P08). out_of_scope lines never receive a cap and never silently become eligible.

fx.rate_convention: INR per one unit of the foreign currency, on the transaction date (P11).

fixtures.notes: Deterministic test rates only. Not market quotes. Any other currency or date requires a supplied documented rate.
Documented card statement rate used by GT110. It intentionally differs from FX-DEMO-2026; a card rate supplied with the claim takes precedence (P11).

vocabularies.readiness_precedence_note: Listed in precedence order; the first applicable value wins (P20).
vocabularies.run_status_note: FAILED_VALIDATION and UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY are asserted by GT116 and GT119 respectively. Extend this list only through a documented revision.

reason_code.display: Amount exceeds the applicable category cap.
Itemized personal or non-reimbursable amount excluded before caps.
Submitted more than 30 calendar days after trip end.
No policy rate is defined for this destination.
Category is outside release 1 scope.
Repeated issuer, receipt number and transaction date held for confirmation.
Matching merchant, date and amount without a shared receipt number.
Readable components do not reconcile with the payable total.
A documented transaction-date rate is required before conversion.
Equally authoritative applicable rules conflict.
Upload does not cover the whole trip; a subtotal is shown.
Signed difference between independently rounded components and the rounded total.
Taxes, mandatory fees, baggage or FX are unknown.
Offer is older than the freshness window or explicitly expired.
Cabin above economy without a recorded exception.
All-in offer price exceeds the applicable cap.
An amount is negative, non-numeric or not finite.
A field needed for a final decision is missing or unreadable.
Extracted fields have not been confirmed by the user.
Required supporting documents are not present.
Dates are missing, reversed or disagree with each other.
Amounts sharing one cap have no documented common-currency basis.
Traveler grade is missing or not E or M.
The service date is outside every published policy window.
Taxes or mandatory fees are not confirmed inside the amount.

vocabularies.reason_code_note: Machine-readable reason codes carry the decision; response prose is generated separately and is what human review grades. No golden case asserts on reasons, so adopting these codes does not change any expected answer.
vocabularies.missing_field_note: A clarification names the specific field using one of these codes plus prose. Never silently default a country, grade, currency or date.

error_code.display: No verified identity on the request.
Session or organization is outside the authorized scope.
The signed-in role is not allowed to perform this action.
The route or the requested resource does not exist in the caller's scope.
Structurally valid request that fails field or cross-field rules.
Image exceeds 10 MiB or the five-image limit. Asserted by GT118.
Upload is not a decodable JPEG or PNG. Asserted by GT117.
More than ten requests for one session inside a minute.
Bounded provider failure after the permitted attempts. No invented data.
A required external capability (vision, embeddings, live search) is not configured.
Total run deadline or call budget reached.
Unexpected server error. Details are logged with the request_id, never returned.

shape.message: human readable, no secrets and no other session data
shape.field: JSON pointer to the offending field or null

error_envelope.rule: Domain clarification is a normal 200 response with missing_fields, not an error. Errors never echo provider credentials, file paths or another session record.

change_control: Adding a value to any vocabulary, country, city tier or FX fixture is a documented revision: update this file, docs/CHANGELOG.txt and any affected schema in the same change.

city_gazetteer.purpose: Maps common city names to package country codes so a question like "hotel cap in Boston" resolves without a model call. Not a policy table: it carries no caps. Unknown cities fall back to model interpretation or a clarification.

country_names.purpose: Words that name a supported country. Any other country name resolves to UNSUPPORTED through model interpretation.
